Bálint's blog
Foreword Voxel tracing is a variation of raytracing which uses a voxelized version of the scene. There are a couple different implementations, but a lot of them rely on branching, which makes the performance suffer when they're used on the GPU. In this article I'll go through the basic algorithm and a potential way to optimize it. This article will assume you have some knowledge of shaders ...
